messages:
Asha (CS): Flagging a sudden usage snap for Hummingbird Health
We saw calls fall from ~500/min to single digits between 02:10-02:30 UTC. No error surge on our side. Noted procurement thread says new interim CTO and a short Nimbus pilot.
Ben (AM): Oof. Any chance this is billing or key rotation?
Riley (Solutions): Checked keys: active and in good standing. Live trace: 
```
2026-03-20T02:05:00Z -> 482 req/min
2026-03-20T02:20:00Z -> 15 req/min
2026-03-20T02:35:00Z -> 7 req/min
```
Pattern looks like a gating policy flipped at client side or an intentional disable.
Ivy (Support): No 5xx/4xx spike. Auth success rate 99.99%. I emailed their SRE and left a note in their ticketing system.
Asha (CS): I pinged the new interim CTO, Mateo, offering a quick security + perf sync. Suggest we propose a 48h isolated canary environment (discounted) and SOC2 + encryption summary up front.
Ben (AM): Please add a short latency p99 snapshot for us-east and eu-west and a one-pager on our private/on-prem timeline. If Mateo escalates to procurement, we should have timing ready.
Riley (Solutions): Will prepare: SOC2 bullets, KMS/HSM notes, latency heatmap, and an offer to run their sample prompts against the canary (to show real p99).
Ivy (Support): If we provision the canary, I can enable request-level tracing (redacted) and a replay hook. Need infra sign-off for short-lived dedicated pool.
Asha (CS): Draft outreach: "Hi Mateo congrats on the new role. We noticed a sharp traffic drop and a Nimbus pilot mentioned in procurement. Would you be open to a 30-min call to walk through security and latency? We can stand up a 48-hour isolated canary with tracing for your SREs to validate, and will share SOC2 + encryption notes ahead of time. 
"
Ben (AM): LGTM. Add a line about our ability to enable private VPC peering or a short-term dedicated node.
Riley (Solutions): Also include that we can run a small, customer-supplied prompt set so they can validate semantic quality and p99 under representative load.
Ivy (Support): ops-bot: create LY-8401 for canary provisioning.
ops-bot: Ticket LY-8401 created (owner: Ivy). Due: 2026-03-22.
Ben (AM): I'll ping infra for approval and pricing. A short promo for 48h should be fine.
Asha (CS): Mateo replied 90m later: "Thanks. 30-min tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Security asked for SOC2, KMS details, and whether you support in-region dedicated pools." I uploaded Riley's draft.
Riley (Solutions): Prep checklist: SOC2 excerpt, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integration notes, and dedicated pool latency numbers. I'll bring a short demo of canary tracing.
Ivy (Support): Standing by to provision once infra confirms. If infra can't do a dedicated pool quick, fallback: demo a routed hosted canary with request-level trace turned on.
Asha (CS): Noted. If Mateo declines the canary, next step: set up an executive QBR with procurement and show the on-prem timeline and compliance docs.
Ben (AM): Keep this channel for updates. We should lock down collateral before the meeting and confirm who will be presenting each slide.
Asha (CS): Will post meeting notes and any follow-ups here after the sync.
